features.scope: Plain headings and escaped literals, paragraphs with nested marks, and source mapping for proof, abstract and nested lists. Browser checks cover editing marked text alongside inline math, including inside a proof. Prose paste and direct typing preserve supported escaped characters, and LuaLaTeX reports a native glyph for the escaped caret. More text environments remain pending.

The browser gates cover empty and nonempty cells and editing marked text and math in the same tabularx cell. Multicolumn and multirow range mapping has direct tests. The real engine reports an empty-cell anchor, marked cell glyphs and an inline formula field with unchanged page drawing on both platforms. Broader table structure and cell styling commands remain pending.

Included prose and display math edit the owning source file. The native exit shortcut resumes typing in the parent. Cross-file copying can include complete display formulas. Adjacent paragraphs support cross-file replacement and undo, including complete inline formulas and surviving marked text. Independent documents switch the compilation entry. Detached fragments inherit the preamble and keep their original source offsets. Verified spacing can show editor-only file dividers and fold complete intervening pages while preserving original numbering and partial edge placeholders. Actual LuaLaTeX tests confirm that edits to a staged child retain both the live and geometry-observation sessions. Broader structural edits and folding where ownership shares the same visual line remain pending.

Real staged PNG drawing metadata is unchanged by ownership. The browser gate selects a raster figure from its painted position and patches its width through the Image controls. Recognized TikZ blocks use the existing visual editor. The native workspace can also select an exact opaque block in Source. Direct hit targets for complex floats and TikZ remain pending.

A registered PDF with matching page dimensions and ownership supports semantic editing. Native geometry from a real two-platform LuaLaTeX run provides browser evidence for editing a formula on a page containing TikZ. Mismatched dimensions disable editing. Editing TikZ itself remains pending.

The native command palette covers verified math structures and the status bar displays the active nested field. The prose palette inserts an exact page break, edits document metadata, and offers project input and include commands.

Copy, cut, paste, whole inline formula selection, synthetic Chinese composition, and queued input during a forced geometry delay. Verified selections within one paragraph copy formatting alongside plain text, and native math accepts validated LaTeX fragments from the clipboard. The browser also covers vertical caret navigation, page navigation, and the textarea anchor during scrolling. Physical input methods and broader cross-file editing remain pending.

The opt-in desktop workspace uses the same native engine session across Document, Source and the read-only Split preview. Source edits reach the same session without rasterizing hidden pages. Browser tests verify that the old paginator and MathLive do not load. Full coverage and physical device checks are required before making this the default.

legacyDisabled.scope: Two-platform Chromium with legacy pagination and MathLive disabled. Mixed prose and display formula edit, undo/redo, root insertion, exact source bytes, plain bold prose, table cells, headings, and synthetic IME. Real LuaLaTeX geometry is replayed in a separate browser gate with a simulated transport.

desktopWebView.scope: GitHub-hosted WebView2 and WKWebView start with legacy pagination and MathLive disabled. The embedded font, PDF worker, and native IPC are checked. Physical key delivery, candidate placement and display scan-out remain separate acceptance items.
